actions: Mechanically inspected pinned CSSC cost-ledger, attribution, action execution, selection, budget, costing, run-state, trace-store, frontier, reducer/proposal and directly relevant test paths.

Confirmed that proposal-batch attribution rewrites historical provider metadata rather than appending an attribution edge, and isolated a proposal-valid REFINE_ARGUMENT no-op seam through which same-batch second consumption remains reachable despite workspace-version invalidation on normal state-changing actions.

Performed an isolated replay of the exact replace-on-batch attribution transformation: node-A attribution followed by node-B changed historical metadata while preserving event ids and measured cost totals. This was not a full repository runtime/test-suite execution.
Verified PRG 2026 paper-level DVS/RGB/few-shot/pretraining/parameter claims against the primary publisher article and scoped author-reported compute/parameter comparisons.
Attempted to resolve the article-declared Zenodo code DOI 10.5281/zenodo.16441066; current web transport did not retrieve the artifact. Recorded this as a retrieval limitation, not code absence.
material_findings: CSSC C209 is verified with a narrower reachability statement: latest-consumer overwrite is real but generally blocked after state-changing first consumers by workspace-version invalidation; proposal-valid reducer no-ops make the two-consumer path reachable.

Targeted CSSC accounting/trace scan does not find a semantic need for provider metadata.action_id, but one explicit structured-controller test requires that legacy presentation. Repository-complete absence elsewhere is not claimed.

CSSC C211-C214 are migration/journal/regression-test proposals, not current behavior; current action-cost event slices cannot reveal the retroactive attribution mutation because it touches pre-event_start provider events and appends no attribution event.

PRG primary paper confirms the worker's headline performance/ablation/pretraining values. Independent source-code reproduction remains unverified until the declared Zenodo artifact is actually fetched and audited.

termination.cause: scheduled invocation checkpoint after two material source-qualified audits; recurring verifier frontier remains nonempty
termination.transient_blocker: Zenodo code artifact could not be resolved through current web transport

exact_next_action: Make one bounded attempt to fetch/pin Zenodo 10.5281/zenodo.16441066 and audit PRG source/reproducibility. If still transport-inaccessible, record the blocker and rotate to C13 cross_field r65 mixed-prefix lemma, separating cited theorem ingredients from worker-derived proof and simulations.
